purpose: Freeze the scope, ownership semantics, canonical relation shape, consumer boundary, and validation rules for the shared Hero <-> Exclusive Equipment relation layer before source investigation begins.

heroPopulation.policy: Use the canonical playable Hero master only. Names are display metadata and never relation keys.

equipmentPopulation.policy: Only the frozen 167-record exclusive-equipment population is admitted into Stage B.

generalEquipment.policy: Never load, relate, enumerate, or derive Hero ownership edges for general equipment in Stage B.

relationSemantics.meaning: The exclusive Equipment canonically belongs to the Hero for exclusive-equipment display and cross-page navigation.
notMeaning: Hero is recommended to use this Equipment
Hero satisfies ArmyIds or JobIds restriction for this Equipment
Release-order, name, icon, or ID-pattern similarity
relationSemantics.consumerRule: Hero and Equipment page pipelines consume the shared relation and must not independently re-derive ownership.

recordShape.heroId: integer; must exist in canonical 267 Hero master
recordShape.equipmentId: integer; must exist in the 167 exclusive-equipment population
recordShape.provenance: non-empty array of admitted explicit ID-based source evidence; exact source kinds are frozen in later Stage B source contract

canonicalEdgeContract.deduplication: The same heroId-equipmentId pair is one canonical edge. Multiple independent evidence sources merge into provenance instead of creating duplicate edges.

ownershipCardinality.policy: Do not hard-code 1:1 cardinality before full-population validation.
ownershipCardinality.expectedObservation: Exclusive Equipment is expected to resolve to one owner Hero and each Hero is expected to own at most one current exclusive Equipment, but this is a validation hypothesis until Stage B full mapping proves it.
ownershipCardinality.schemaConsequence: Both directions remain array-capable until Stage B validation freezes actual cardinality invariants.

derivedIndexContract.authority: Indexes are derived from the canonical edge set only. Index contents must never patch or override canonical ownership.

sourceAdmissionBoundary.stageB0Decision: B-0 does not declare the production ownership source. Source discovery and admission are B-1/B-2 work.
requiredPropertiesForFutureSource: Produces or supports an explicit Hero ID <-> Equipment ID relation through actual ConfigData fields or a verified ID chain
Can be traced to source record identity and field-level provenance
Does not require name similarity, icon similarity, numeric ordering, release order, or other heuristic inference
Can be tested on representative fixtures before full-population generation

missionType77.example: Hero 6 Leon SP mission -> MissionType 77 -> Param1 Equipment 416
missionType77.meaning: MissionType 77 Param1 is an exclusive Equipment ID in the verified Leon fixture.
missionType77.boundary: This does not prove that MissionType 77 is the canonical ownership source for all 167 exclusive Equipment records. It may be used for B-2 cross-validation unless B-1 proves broader source coverage.

forbiddenInference: Equipment icon or asset filename similarity
Hero icon or asset filename similarity
Hero ID and Equipment ID numeric proximity or ordering
equipment subtype, ArmyIds, or JobIds eligibility
forcing 167/167 mapping by heuristic when explicit evidence is missing

consumerBoundaries.heroStage5_2: Consume byHero index, then join equipmentId to the frozen exclusive-equipment consumer payload. Hero Stage 5-2 must not reopen ConfigData to infer ownership.
consumerBoundaries.equipmentPage: Consume byEquipment index, then join heroId to canonical Hero identity/page data. Equipment page must not infer owner from names, restrictions, or ordering.
consumerBoundaries.generalEquipment: Any future 'this Hero can equip these general items' feature belongs to a separate eligibility/search-index stage and must not extend or mutate Stage B.

hardRequirementsForStageB: input Hero IDs are restricted to the canonical 267 Hero master
input Equipment IDs are restricted to exactly the exclusive-equipment population
no launch, legacy-additional, current-additional, soul-special, or unresolved-no-path record appears in canonical edges or indexes
every canonical edge contains valid heroId, valid exclusive equipmentId, relationType exclusive, non-empty provenance, and explicit verificationStatus
byHero and byEquipment are generated only from canonical edges
heuristic inference contributes zero production edges
validationPolicy.targetInterpretation: 167/167 is a goal, not a reason to fabricate evidence. Any record that cannot be explicitly resolved remains REVIEW/unmapped until a valid source is found.

plannedStageSequence: B-4 full relation validation and cardinality freeze
B-6 Hero Stage 5-2 and Equipment-page consumer admission
completion: B-0 is complete when Stage B is frozen as an exclusive-equipment-only shared ownership relation layer, general Equipment is explicitly excluded, the canonical edge and derived-index shapes are fixed, heuristic relation generation is forbidden, and B-1 may investigate explicit ID-based ownership sources without changing scope.
